_meta.description: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003 — Rules applicable to Independent Residential Houses (G+3 maximum)

rules.title: Minimum Plot Area
rules.error_message: Plot area {actual} sqm is below the minimum {expected} sqm required for residential house construction.
rules.recommendation: Minimum plot area of 50 sqm is mandatory. Consolidate adjacent plots or reconsider building type.
rules.explanation: BBMP mandates a minimum plot area to ensure adequate open space, ventilation, and structural safety for residential buildings.

rules.title: Minimum Plot Width
rules.error_message: Plot width {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m required for residential house construction.
rules.recommendation: Minimum plot width of 4.5 m is required to accommodate setbacks and a habitable building.
rules.explanation: A minimum width ensures the plot can accommodate front setback, building width, and rear setback.

rules.title: Minimum Plot Depth
rules.error_message: Plot depth {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m.
rules.recommendation: Minimum plot depth of 9 m is required for residential construction.
rules.explanation: Adequate plot depth ensures sufficient space for the building footprint and mandatory setbacks.

rules.title: Minimum Abutting Road Width
rules.error_message: Abutting road width {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m required for residential construction.
rules.recommendation: Building permission cannot be granted on a plot abutting a road less than 6 m wide. Apply for road widening or choose an alternate plot.
rules.explanation: A minimum road width ensures emergency vehicle access and adequate vehicular movement.

rules.title: Electrical Line Clearance
rules.bye_law_reference: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Clause 8.3; BESCOM Safety Regulations
rules.error_message: Electrical line clearance {actual} m is below the minimum safe clearance of {expected} m.
rules.recommendation: Contact BESCOM for shifting of overhead lines or redesign building to maintain 1.5 m clearance.
rules.explanation: Safe clearance from overhead electrical lines prevents electrocution risk during construction and occupancy.

rules.title: Front Setback — Road Width 6 m to 9 m
rules.error_message: Front setback {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m for a road width of 6–9 m.
rules.recommendation: Increase front setback to at least 1.5 m from the road boundary.
rules.explanation: Front setback preserves street character, provides emergency access, and ensures natural light to the building.

rules.title: Front Setback — Road Width 9 m to 12 m
rules.error_message: Front setback {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m for a road width of 9–12 m.
rules.recommendation: Increase front setback to at least 2.0 m from the road boundary.
rules.explanation: Wider roads require proportionally larger front setbacks to maintain an urban character and safety buffer.

rules.title: Front Setback — Road Width ≥ 12 m
rules.error_message: Front setback {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m for a road width ≥ 12 m.
rules.recommendation: Increase front setback to at least 3.0 m from the road boundary.
rules.explanation: Buildings abutting major roads require 3 m front setback to ensure pedestrian safety and street aesthetics.

rules.title: Rear Setback — Plot Area < 150 sqm
rules.error_message: Rear setback {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m for plot area < 150 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Maintain at least 1.0 m rear setback to allow natural light and ventilation.
rules.explanation: Rear setback ensures light and ventilation access to the rear of the building and to adjacent properties.

rules.title: Rear Setback — Plot Area 150–300 sqm
rules.error_message: Rear setback {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m for plot area 150–300 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Increase rear setback to at least 1.5 m.
rules.explanation: Larger plots have proportionally larger rear setback requirements.

rules.title: Rear Setback — Plot Area > 300 sqm
rules.error_message: Rear setback {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m for plot area > 300 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Increase rear setback to at least 2.0 m.
rules.explanation: Large plots require more generous rear setback to maintain overall open space character.

rules.title: Side Setback — Plot Area < 150 sqm
rules.error_message: Minimum side setback {actual} m is below the required {expected} m for plot area < 150 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Maintain at least 1.0 m on each side for light, ventilation, and maintenance access.
rules.explanation: Side setbacks prevent buildings from touching boundaries, allowing natural light and ventilation.

rules.title: Side Setback — Plot Area 150–300 sqm
rules.error_message: Minimum side setback {actual} m is below the required {expected} m for plot area 150–300 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Increase side setback to at least 1.2 m on both sides.
rules.explanation: Side setbacks proportional to plot size ensure equitable access to light and air.

rules.title: Side Setback — Plot Area > 300 sqm
rules.error_message: Minimum side setback {actual} m is below the required {expected} m for plot area > 300 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Increase side setback to at least 1.5 m on both sides.
rules.explanation: Large plots must maintain proportionally larger side setbacks.

rules.title: Maximum Building Height
rules.error_message: Building height {actual} m exceeds the maximum {expected} m permitted for residential houses.
rules.recommendation: Reduce building height to 15 m (G+3) or obtain high-rise approval separately.
rules.explanation: Residential houses are limited to G+3 (15 m) to maintain residential character and ensure structural safety without special approvals.

rules.title: Maximum Number of Storeys
rules.error_message: Building has {actual} storeys, exceeding the maximum {expected} storeys (G+3) for a residential house.
rules.recommendation: Reduce to G+3 or apply for high-rise/apartment approval.
rules.explanation: Residential houses are limited to Ground + 3 upper floors (4 total storeys) under BBMP 2003 bye-laws.

rules.title: Minimum Floor-to-Floor Height (Habitable)
rules.error_message: Minimum storey height {actual} m is below the required {expected} m for habitable floors.
rules.recommendation: Increase floor-to-ceiling height to at least 2.75 m in all habitable rooms.
rules.explanation: Adequate floor height ensures proper ventilation, comfort, and compliance with NBC standards.

rules.title: Maximum FAR — Plot Area 50–150 sqm
rules.error_message: FAR {actual} exceeds the permitted maximum {expected} for plot area 50–150 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Reduce total built-up area to maintain FAR ≤ 2.25. Consider redistributing floors.
rules.explanation: FAR (Floor Area Ratio) controls the intensity of development relative to plot area.

rules.title: Maximum FAR — Plot Area 150–300 sqm
rules.error_message: FAR {actual} exceeds the permitted maximum {expected} for plot area 150–300 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Reduce total built-up area to FAR ≤ 2.0.
rules.explanation: Medium-sized plots have a lower permitted FAR to reduce neighbourhood density.

rules.title: Maximum FAR — Plot Area > 300 sqm
rules.error_message: FAR {actual} exceeds the permitted maximum {expected} for plot area > 300 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Reduce total built-up area to FAR ≤ 1.75 for large plots.
rules.explanation: Large plots are restricted to lower FAR values to maintain open space and reduce urban density.

rules.title: Maximum Ground Coverage — Plot Area ≤ 150 sqm
rules.error_message: Ground coverage {actual}% exceeds the maximum {expected}% permitted for plots ≤ 150 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Reduce building footprint to occupy no more than 60% of plot area.
rules.explanation: Ground coverage limits ensure open space around the building for light, ventilation, and emergency access.

rules.title: Maximum Ground Coverage — Plot Area 150–300 sqm
rules.error_message: Ground coverage {actual}% exceeds the maximum {expected}% permitted for plots 150–300 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Reduce building footprint to at most 55% of plot area.
rules.explanation: Medium plots require more open space proportionally to support neighbourhood green cover.

rules.title: Maximum Ground Coverage — Plot Area > 300 sqm
rules.error_message: Ground coverage {actual}% exceeds the maximum {expected}% for plots > 300 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Reduce building footprint to at most 50% of plot area.
rules.explanation: Large plots must leave at least 50% open to support biodiversity and storm water management.

rules.title: Garage / Parking Stall — Minimum Width
rules.error_message: Garage/stall width {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m.
rules.recommendation: Widen garage to at least 2.5 m to allow a standard car plus door-opening clearance.
rules.explanation: Minimum stall width of 2.5 m accommodates standard vehicles and enables safe door opening.

rules.title: Garage / Parking Stall — Minimum Length
rules.error_message: Garage/stall length {actual} m is below the minimum {expected} m.
rules.recommendation: Lengthen garage to at least 5.0 m to accommodate a standard passenger vehicle.
rules.explanation: Minimum stall length of 5.0 m allows parking of a standard car with room for driver ingress/egress.

rules.title: Rainwater Harvesting — Plot Area ≥ 100 sqm
rules.bye_law_reference: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Clause 11.1; BWSSB Notification 2009
rules.error_message: Rainwater harvesting system is not installed. It is mandatory for plots ≥ 100 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Install a rainwater harvesting pit as per BBMP guidelines. Minimum pit size and percolation specifications must be included in the building plan.
rules.explanation: BBMP mandates rainwater harvesting for all buildings on plots ≥ 100 sqm to replenish groundwater.

rules.title: Solar Water Heater — Plot Area ≥ 60 sqm
rules.bye_law_reference: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Clause 11.2; BESCOM Solar Policy
rules.error_message: Solar water heater is not provided. It is required for plots ≥ 60 sqm.
rules.recommendation: Incorporate a solar water heater (minimum 100 LPD capacity per BESCOM guidelines) into the building design.
rules.explanation: Solar water heaters are mandatory under BBMP and BESCOM regulations to reduce electricity consumption.
